name: pr-review
description: A project tab that reviews a pull request as a guided, staged discussion with a local model: a walkthrough, a quality pass, the key changes a few files at a time, then a skim pile, with a chat beside the code. The review is posted to GitHub or sent to Firstmate only when you click.

model.title: Local model
model.description: The Ollama model each review stage runs on, such as qwen2.5:7b or llama3.1.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama address
ollamaUrl.description: Where Ollama answers on this computer.

contextTokens.title: Context window (tokens)
contextTokens.description: How much the model reads at once: at least 4096. Bigger reads more of a stage's diff but needs more memory.

extraGenerated.title: Also hide as generated
extraGenerated.description: File names (a * matches any part of a name), paths, or folders ending in /, hidden like build output. dist/, build/, lockfiles and snapshots are always hidden.
